title: Fatima's $7,000 Side Hustle Had a $1,800 Surprise

scenes.say: Fatima owed about $1,800 in tax on a $7,000 side hustle.
She tutors on weekends. No employer, so nothing was withheld.
Self-employment tax alone was roughly $990. That's Social Security and Medicare.
Then regular income tax, at her 12% bracket, added about $780.
So she now moves 25% of every payment into a separate account.
By spring, the bill is already sitting there.
Her rule: set aside a quarter, track costs, and look into quarterly payments.
Do you save for tax on side income? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because $7,000 earned can mean $1,800 owed.
